reviewProtocol.classificationRule: Do not carry forward maturity labels as newly verified. A source desk review does not equal functional re-execution. Open PRs are assessed as provisional candidates and never promoted to main/release.
reviewProtocol.publicationGate: HOLD until all modified/new projects are source-reviewed, updated documents are synchronized, static regressions pass and real website browser checks are recorded.
reviewProtocol.reReviewTrigger: New source repository, merged revision, open candidate that changes product claims, change to legal/rights status, evidence or sales description.
